orig: si te acercas a los matorrales
veo la city desde lo alto
con las cuentas de un rosario
de mi abuela entre las manos
vi que te pone mi tanga
en: if you come near the brambles
careful, don't get pricked
there's thistles, thorns and daggers
in the dark I climb the scaffolding
I see the city from up high
sleepless cat eyes
drop by drop fills the glasses
with the beads of a rosary
my grandma's, in my hands
dissociating between screams
brawl and fandangos
I saw my thong turns you on
peeking out of your tracksuit
tonight I'll light you a little candle
and I'll pour you the wax
eu: hor dago kardua, elorria eta labanak
tanta eta tanta edalontziak betetzen dira
ikusi dut nire tanga gustatzen zaizula

orig: Sácame del coche aunque tengas que arrastrar
el peso autodestructivo de este pobre animal
me quedé pegando todas las piecitas
respira y come bien que yo siempre te iré a buscar
en: Get me out of the car even if you have to drag
the self-destructive weight of this poor animal
I stayed behind gluing all the little pieces back together
breathe and eat well, I'll always come find you
eu: Atera nazazu autotik, arrastatu behar baduzu ere
geratu nintzen pieza txiki guztiak itsasten
arnasa hartu eta jan ondo, nik beti zure bila etorriko naiz

orig: y a partir de ahora mia
en: I twist up a bun while I listen
to what he told me in the voice note
I want you so bad
the kidnapping was the prelude
come on, don't think it over anymore
don't leave it feeling off
and from now on, mine
your will
eu: ile-motots bat egiten dut entzuten dudan bitartean

orig: ez dut utziko ezertxo ere zure ohean
guzti guztia eramango dut, eramango dut
en: you rejoice when you sense fear
today I'll disguise it, my suffering
I won't leave a single thing in your bed
I'll take absolutely everything, I'll take it
es: te alegras cuando notas el miedo
no dejaré nada de nada en tu cama
me lo llevaré absolutamente todo, me lo llevaré

orig: a los mismos que vieron nacer
en: tonight there's no mooring
let it hold, let it grab on
she kidnapped the storms
so the tempest kills
the very ones who saw her born
lamias cursing in the forests
They heard her lament
and it rained poison
they drowned the food
they weren't paying attention
the blessed ones quickly went away
the cries, the cries of the night voices
es: los gritos de las voces de la noche, los gritos
